name: Suez
verdict: SUEZ is privately held by a consortium: Meridiam 38.3%, Global Infrastructure Partners (a part of BlackRock) 38.3%, Caisse des Dépôts and CNP Assurances 18.8% and employee shareholders 4.4%. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: co-title sponsor of FDJ United-Suez. Caisse des Dépôts (with CNP Assurances) holds 18.8% of SUEZ and is described by SUEZ as 'a French public-sector financial institution' — a French-state link of more than 5%, but France doesn't count as a record under METHOD.md (maintainer decision of September 2026, for Renault: findings of excessive police force and racial profiling are not a record of this kind), so the rating is none. Source disagreement: Cyclist (July 2025 snapshot) calls Suez 'listed on the Paris and Brussels Euronext exchanges', while SUEZ's own governance page presents a private consortium holding via SUEZ Holding; the company's own page is treated as authoritative.
